description: This line plot illustrates the validation performance, measured by BPC (Bits Per Character), of two models—XMoE Validating and SimSMoE Validating—as a function of training steps. The x-axis represents Training Steps on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 50,000 (indicated as 50 × 10³), with tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis represents BPC on a linear scale, ranging from 1.25 to 2.25. The XMoE Validating line is depicted in yellow with a dashed line style and circular markers, starting at approximately 2.20 BPC and decreasing to about 1.25 BPC. The SimSMoE Validating line is shown in magenta with a solid line style and star-shaped markers, beginning at approximately 2.23 BPC and also decreasing to about 1.25 BPC. Both lines exhibit a rapid initial decline in BPC, followed by a stabilization at a similar low value, with the magenta line showing a slightly more gradual descent before leveling off.
